notes: Fix: network services self-start when the link comes up. ethConnected now tracks the live ETH state instead of a boot-time snapshot, so a DHCP lease arriving after initEthernet's 15s timeout no longer leaves the board pingable but headless with OTA disabled. All seven Vineyard boards hit this simultaneously on 2026-09-22 after a power event and each needed a physical cycle; a late lease or a cable/switch bounce now self-recovers.
